description:
Systematic review of human-authored documentation files in the BenchBox project
to ensure accuracy, completeness, and quality. Each document will be
reviewed using /docs-review, with all recommended fixes applied.

File Scope (249 total files):
- Human-authored docs: ~170 files (IN SCOPE - full review)
- Auto-generated _tags/: ~47 files (EXCLUDED - spot-check only)
- Auto-generated reference/python-api/: ~30 files (EXCLUDED - verify build works)
- Build artifacts (_build/, _static/): 2 files (EXCLUDED)

This audit addresses documentation quality issues discovered during
the performance.md review, which revealed critical issues including:
- Non-existent CLI flags documented
- Invalid import statements in code examples
- Broken Unicode characters in headers
- Misleading performance claims
- Missing prerequisites sections

The goal is to bring all documentation to a consistent quality standard
with verified code examples, accurate CLI references, and working links.

Commit Strategy: Per-phase commits for reviewability. Each phase completion
gets its own commit with summary of changes made.
